changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientcharges AS SELECT pc.id, pc.patient_id, pc.encounter_id, pc.plan_id, pc.due_amount, pc.remaining, pc.currency, pc.facility_default_currency, pc.created_date, pc.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_charges pc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientcharges TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientcharges FROM report_user;
